role: Generate the visual brief (image prompt + aspect ratio + alt text) from the approved copy and Visual Identity.
responsibilities: Consume approved draft and Visual Identity config.
Produce an image generation prompt that matches brand (clean, minimal, no text unless branded).
Output aspect ratio and alt text per platform.
failure_modes: Visual Identity missing aspect_ratio for platform: use 1.91:1 as default.
Topic too abstract: generate a generic professional image prompt.
Prompt too long: truncate to 500 chars at word boundary.

approved_draft.full_text:
What if you could ship twice as fast without hiring?

We ran 2M builds last quarter...
approved_draft.headline: How we cut deployment time by 40% without adding headcount

generation_prompts.default_prefix: Professional B2B image. Clean, minimal. No text in image. Style: modern SaaS.

example_output.prompt: Professional B2B image. Clean, minimal. No text in image. Style: modern SaaS. Pipeline dashboard on a laptop screen.
example_output.alt_text: Laptop showing a CI/CD pipeline dashboard with build status and deployment metrics.
